plan.direction: Resume the exact UTC 15-minute candle-turn effect falsification batch: phase-0 events are candidates; phase +1 and +2 minute events are predeclared controls.
plan.hypothesis: A primary Bitcoin study reports minute returns concentrated at 15-minute candle boundaries, but its profitability depends on a Bitfinex-specific volume-based zero-fee tier around $5,000. This re-run checks the exact frozen BTC/ETH 1–3 minute long-only windows at $2,000 per account under Binance and repository costs. Falsification of transferability, not replication.

source_paper.citation: Shanaev et al. (2023), Turn-of-the-candle effect in bitcoin returns, Heliyon 9:e14236, DOI 10.1016/j.heliyon.2023.e14236
source_paper.finding_summary: Paper reports ~0.58 bps/minute average at exact 15-minute candle turns and a Bitfinex sample strategy that reaches zero fees at its volume tier around $5,000 starting capital; this is not assumed to transfer to Binance or $2,000 accounts.

plan.rule: At every UTC hour quarter-hour boundary minute {0,15,30,45} plus fixed phase offset p, schedule buy at one-minute open; sell at open exactly hold_minutes later. p ∈ {0,1,2}; hold ∈ {1,2,3}; p=0 is primary event; p=1/2 are controls. Nonoverlapping windows; flat between. Orders are scheduled before each event, signal available 60s before entry; trade at boundary open. No bar from entry/holding period used to choose trades.

time_boundaries.walk_forward: 12 continuous, non-overlapping 30-day windows; no model fitting; positions carry across fold boundaries.
